title: Stripe connection failures after payment-service deploy
root_cause: Hardcoded Stripe endpoint URL overwritten by config change in deploy v2.13.5
resolution: Rollback to v2.13.4 + config fix in v2.13.6. Added Stripe connectivity health check to deploy pipeline.
similarity_reason: Same service, same error pattern (connection refused to Stripe), post-deploy trigger
summary: Payment-service deployment v2.13.5 introduced a configuration change that pointed the Stripe gateway URL to an internal staging endpoint. All checkout requests failed with connection refused errors. Resolved by rollback within 18 minutes.
